# SKV Mahal

> A centrally air-conditioned hall for 1,000 guests on one acre, behind the Mogappair East bus terminal — with parking for 150+ cars.

Website: https://skvmahal.in/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 96000 32214

## Contact
- SKV Mahal · No 6, TNEB Road, Mogappair East, Chennai 600 037 · Opposite the E.B. Office, behind Mogappair East bus terminal · +91 96000 32214 · 044 4864 0545 · skvmahalchennai@gmail.com

## Key facts
- 1,000 guests seated, fully A/C
- 300 seats in the A/C dining hall
- 150 cars parked, and more
- 6 A/C double guest rooms

## Facilities
- Centralised A/C
- Bride & groom rooms by the stage
- Wide stage, many backdrops
- Chettinadu-style corridor
- A/C dining hall
- Two staircases to dining
- Guest-room lift
- Modern kitchen with goods lift
- Vegetable cutting & grinders
- 24x7 generator
- CCTV & security
- 2,500 sq ft mini hall

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can SKV Mahal hold?
SKV Mahal seats 1,000 guests in its centrally air-conditioned hall, and 300 at a time in the A/C dining hall.

### Where is SKV Mahal?
No 6, TNEB Road, Mogappair East, Chennai 600 037 (Opposite the E.B. Office, behind Mogappair East bus terminal).

### What facilities does SKV Mahal have?
Centralised A/C, Bride & groom rooms by the stage, Wide stage, many backdrops, Chettinadu-style corridor, A/C dining hall, Two staircases to dining, Guest-room lift, Modern kitchen with goods lift, Vegetable cutting & grinders, 24x7 generator, CCTV & security, 2,500 sq ft mini hall.

### Is there a smaller space for sangeet or mehendi?
Yes. The 2,500 sq ft front area is available separately, with its own restroom and wash area.

### Is there parking?
Yes — open parking for 150+ cars, with security guards and CCTV.

### How do I check if SKV Mahal is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 96000 32214.
